children.title: Cycle 2 · Investigating Experience-Based Preference Formation Through Peircean Semiotics

detail.title: Investigating Experience-Based Preference Formation Through Peircean Semiotics
detail.summary: Synthesizing collected literature on Charles Sanders Peirce's pragmatic semiotics to examine how experience and sign interpretation contribute to stable habit formation and evaluation.

children.title: Cycle 1 · Initiating Project on Emergent Preferences via Experience

detail.title: Initiating Project on Emergent Preferences via Experience
detail.summary: We establish a project exploring how accumulated experience can produce stable, observable preferences without explicit programming, utilizing collected evidence on pragmatic semiotics and human-centred AI.
